summary: VMware ESXi contains an authentication bypass vulnerability. title: CVE-2023-45249: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) Insecure Default Password Vulnerability
summary: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands remotely due to the use of default passwords.

title: CVE-2024-5217: ServiceNow Incomplete List of Disallowed Inputs Vulnerability
summary: ServiceNow Washington DC, Vancouver, and earlier Now Platform releases contain an incomplete list of disallowed inputs vulnerability in the GlideExpression script. An unauthenticated user could exploit this vulnerability to execute code remotely.

title: CVE-2024-4879: ServiceNow Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
summary: ServiceNow Utah, Vancouver, and Washington DC Now Platform releases contain a jelly template injection vulnerability in UI macros. An unauthenticated user could exploit this vulnerability to execute code remotely.

title: CVE-2024-39891: Twilio Authy Information Disclosure Vulnerability
summary: Twilio Authy contains an information disclosure vulnerability in its API that allows an unauthenticated endpoint to accept a request containing a phone number and respond with information about whether the phone number was registered with Authy.

title: CVE-2012-4792: Microsoft Internet Explorer Use-After-Free Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted web site that triggers access to an object that (1) was not properly allocated or (2) is deleted, as demonstrated by a CDwnBindInfo object.

title: CVE-2022-22948: VMware vCenter Server Incorrect Default File Permissions Vulnerability
summary: VMware vCenter Server contains an incorrect default file permissions vulnerability that allows a remote, privileged attacker to gain access to sensitive information.

title: CVE-2024-28995: SolarWinds Serv-U Path Traversal Vulnerability
summary: SolarWinds Serv-U contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker access to read sensitive files on the host machine.

title: CVE-2024-34102: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference (XXE) Vulnerability
summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper restriction of XML external entity reference (XXE) vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

title: CVE-2024-36401: OSGeo GeoServer GeoTools Eval Injection Vulnerability
summary: OSGeo GeoServer GeoTools contains an improper neutralization of directives in dynamically evaluated code vulnerability due to unsafely evaluating property names as XPath expressions. This allows unauthenticated attackers to conduct remote code execution via specially crafted input.

title: CVE-2024-23692: Rejetto HTTP File Server Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
summary: Rejetto HTTP File Server contains an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability. This allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute commands on the affected system by sending a specially crafted HTTP request.

title: CVE-2024-38080: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows a local attacker with user permissions to gain SYSTEM privileges.

title: CVE-2024-38112: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform Spoofing Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains a spoofing vulnerability that has a high impact to confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

title: CVE-2024-20399: Cisco NX-OS Command Injection Vulnerability
summary: Cisco NX-OS contains a command injection vulnerability in the command line interface (CLI) that could allow an authenticated, local attacker to execute commands as root on the underlying operating system of an affected device.

title: Lucid USA, Inc.: Software Error May Cause a Loss of Drive Power (5,251 affected)
summary: Lucid USA, Inc. (Lucid) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Air vehicles.  When a hardware communication fault is detected, the High Voltage Interlock (HVIL) software could disconnect the high voltage contactors while the vehicle is in motion, causing a loss of drive power.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Windshield Air Bubbles Can Obscure VIN/FMVSS 205 (1,608 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2024 Nissan Sentra vehicles.  The windshield may have air bubbles on the front lower driver's side, which can obscure the Vehicle Identification Number (VIN).  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 205, "Glazing Materials."

title: Vermeer Manufacturing Company: Improperly Tightened Axle Mounting Bolts (84 affected)
summary: Vermeer Manufacturing Company (Vermeer) is recalling certain 2024 BC1200XL brush chippers.  The mounting bolts which secures the axle to the mainframe may not have been properly tightened.

title: Fisker Group Inc: Water Pump Failure Can Cause Loss of Drive Power (7,545 affected)
summary: Fisker Group Inc (Fisker) is recalling all 2023-2024 Ocean vehicles.  A communication failure with the cabin electric water pump can cause the high voltage battery management system (BMS) to enter limp mode, causing a loss of drive power.

title: ARBOC Specialty Vehicles, LLC: Seat Back Malfunction/FMVSS 207 (14 affected)
summary: ARBOC Specialty Vehicles, LLC (ARBOC) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Spirit of Freedom vehicles, equipped with certain GO-ES Space Saver Foldaway Seats.  The recliner mechanism may not engage when the seat back is fully reclined.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 207, "Seating Systems."

title: E-One Incorporated: Lower Control Arm Retention Fasteners Can Fail (3 affected)
summary: E-One Incorporated (E-One) is recalling certain 2024 Cyclone N and Typhoon N vehicles equipped with an independent front suspension assembly.  The lower control arm retention bolts could become brittle and break after being tightened.

title: Forest River Bus, LLC: Emergency Exit Handles are Inaccessible/FMVSS 217 (62 affected)
summary: Forest River Bus, LLC (Forest River) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Starcraft Starlite transit buses.  The emergency exit handles and labels are not easily accessible which can prevent or delay the exit of passengers in the event of an emergency.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Incorrect Heat Treatment Can Cause Tie Rod Failure (12 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2025 VN and VHD trucks equipped with Composilite EXS20 steerable lift axle suspension assemblies.  The tie rod assembly ball stud could have been improperly heat treated and can fail.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Incorrect Heat Treatment Can Cause Tie Rod Failure (59 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2025 LR, Granite, and Pinnacle vehicles equipped with Composilite EXS20 steerable lift axle suspension assemblies.  The tie rod assembly ball stud could have been improperly heat treated and can fail.

title: Spartan Fire, LLC: Lower Control Arm Retention Fasteners Can Fail (48 affected)
summary: Spartan Fire, LLC (Spartan Fire) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Gladiator, 2024-2025 Metro Star and 2024 KME Panther vehicles equipped with certain independent front suspension assemblies.  The lower control arm retention bolts could become brittle and break after being tightened.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Missing Tire Information/FMVSS 139 (1,725 affected)
summary: Honda (America Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2024 CR-V vehicles.  The tire identification number (TIN) is missing the four-digit date code.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 139, "New Pneumatic Radial Tires for Light Vehicles."

title: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc.: Missing Spare Tire Wheel Bolts (282 affected)
summary: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc. (Tiffin) is recalling certain 2024 Tiffin Convoy, 2022 Cahaba, and 2023, 2025 Tiffin GH1 motorhomes.  The wheel bolts for the spare tire may be missing.

title: Hendrickson Mt. Vernon, LLC: Lower Control Arm Retention Fasteners Can Fail (58 affected)
summary: Reyco Granning (Reyco) is recalling certain IFS20FT, IFS22FT, and IFS24FT independent front suspension assemblies, with part number 710244-01.  The lower control arm retention bolts could become brittle and break after being tightened.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Incorrect Heat Treatment Can Cause Tie Rod Failure (61 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2025 Freightliner Cascadia, 114SD, Western Star 47X, and 49X transit buses equipped with Composolite EXS20 steerable lift axle suspension assemblies.  The tie rod assembly ball stud could have been improperly heat treated and can fail.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Front Seat Air Bag May Not Deploy As Intended (337,128 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2017-2024 Alfa Romeo Giulia, 2018-2025 Alfa Romeo Stelvio, 2019-2023 Fiat 500X, Jeep Renegade, and 2024 Fiat 500E vehicles.  A seat belt buckle switch sensor may be improperly connected, preventing the front seat air bag from deploying as intended.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Brake Lights May Fail to Illuminate (37 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Freightliner Custom Chassis S2C 106 and 2024-2025 Freightliner Custom Chassis S2RV 106 vehicles.  The brake lights may not illuminate when the brakes are automatically applied during an active brake assist (ABA) event.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Incorrect Tire Information on Labels/FMVSS 110 (9,037 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2017-2024 Alfa Romeo Giulia and 2021-2024 Alfa Romeo Stelvio vehicles.  The tire pressure and size information on the tire placard and manufacturer labels are incorrect.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Driver's Air Bag Inflator May Explode (394,029 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2006-2011 3 Series Sedan (324i, 325i, 325xi, 328i, 328xi, 330i, 330xi, 335i, 335xi), 2006-2012 3 Series Sportswagon (325xi, 328i, 328xi), and 2009-2011 3 Series Sedan (335d) vehicles.  The original steering wheel may have been replaced with a sport or M-sport steering wheel equipped with an inflator that can explode during deployment.

title: Carparts.com, Inc.: Insufficient Illumination from Lights/FMVSS 108 (1,826 affected)
summary: Carparts.com, Inc. (Carparts.com) is recalling certain MH Taillights, models MHD730145, MHD730146, MHG730125, MHG730126, MHH730117, MHH730118, MHJ730143, MHJ730144, and MH Headlights, models MHK100169, MHK100170, MHN100189, and MHN100190.  The taillights and headlights do not illuminate sufficiently.  As such, these lights fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Gillig, LLC: Loss of Steering Control from Loose Steering Shaft (1,189 affected)
summary: Gillig, LLC (Gillig) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Low Floor transit buses.  The steering spline shaft fasteners may have been improperly tightened, allowing the steering spline shaft to loosen.

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Incorrectly Aligned Windshield Wipers May Collide (34 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2022-2023 LFS buses.  The windshield wiper arms may be incorrectly aligned, which can cause the wiper blades to collide.

title: Autocar, LLC: Road Hazard from Cab Tilt Hinge Pin Detachment (841 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2023-2024 ACX (Xpeditor).  The retaining ring could be missing from the cab tilt hinge pin, leaving the pin unsecured.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Side Curtain Air Bag May Not Deploy/FMVSS 214, 226 (13 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Jeep Cherokee vehicles.  An improperly secured connector for the right-side curtain air bag may prevent the air bag from deploying as intended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 214, "Side Impact Protection" and 226, "Ejection Mitigation."

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Parking Brake May Unintentionally Engage (900 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2021-2024 LFS and 2021-2023 LFS Artic buses.  An air leak may occur in the parking brake valve and unintentionally engage the parking brake without activating the brake lights.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Improperly Tightened Bolts on Dashboard (7 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2023 GLC 300 4MATIC vehicles.  Certain dashboard area bolts may have been insufficiently tightened, potentially causing improper air bag deployment or parts separation during a crash.  In addition, the 12-Volt electric auxiliary heater connections may be loose, possibly causing the electrical wiring to overheat.

title: Volvo Bus Corporation: Steering Gear Link Rod Improperly Tightened (10 affected)
summary: Volvo Bus Corporation (Volvo Bus) is recalling certain 2024 Volvo 9700 vehicles.  The castellated nuts securing the steering gear link rod to the steering arm and/or the pitman arm may not have been tightened properly, which can allow it to loosen.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Wheelchair May Become Unstable/FVMSS 403 & 404 (2,653 affected)
summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2005-2024 X3-45, 2017-2019 and 2021-2023 X3-45 Commuter, 2006-2007, 2014, and 2018 H3-41, 2005-2020 and 2022-2024 H3-45, and 2019 H3-45 VIP buses equipped with a wheelchair lift.  The wheelchair platform bridging device may be too steep, which can cause the wheelchair to become unstable.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 403, "Platform Lift Devices" and 404, "Platform Lift Installations."

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Improperly Heat-Treated Rear Axle Spring U-Bolts (1,232 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter vehicles.  The spring U-bolts for the rear axle may have reduced strength due to improper heat-treatment, which can cause the rear axle to shift out of position.

title: Safe Fleet: Mirror Control Switch May Fail and Overheat (3,853 affected)
summary: Specialty Manufacturing Co. (Safe Fleet) submitted a defect information report based upon the recall determinations made by Gillig, LLC (23V-812) and BYD Coach & Bus (24V-374). The fuse in the mirror control switch may be under-rated for the vehicle application, which can result in the switch overheating in the event of a short-circuit or voltage spike.

title: Keystone RV Company: Incorrectly Attached Metal Sidewalls (393 affected)
summary: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2024 Springdale 245ML, Hideout 24L0F, Aspen Trail 260THLOFT, 360THLOFT, and Colorado 360THLOFT travel trailers.  The metal sidewall may be incorrectly attached and come loose during transit.

title: Grand Design RV, LLC: Wiring Missing Circuit Protection (734 affected)
summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2024 Reflection travel trailers.  The electrical wiring may be missing over current circuit protection.

title: Dongguan Biaoming technology Co., Ltd.: Charger Adapter May Overheat or Not Latch Properly (24 affected)
summary: Dongguan Biaoming technology Co., Ltd. Inc is recalling certain Tesla Charger (NACS) to Combined Charging System (CCS) adapters with part number Jeco041, sold by JecoEV through Amazon.  The charging cable adapter was manufactured without over-temperature circuit protection and the adapter may not securely latch to the charger.

title: Terex South Dakota, Inc.: Boom Basket Retaining Pin Failure (172 affected)
summary: Terex South Dakota, Inc. (Terex) is recalling certain 2020-2024 XT Pro vehicles equipped with replacement basket brackets.  The replacement basket brackets may not be compatible with the original basket retaining pins and cause the basket to unintentionally tilt.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Driver's Air Bag Inflator May Explode (1,145 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2015 6 Series Gran Coupe, 2014 5 Series Gran Turismo, 2014 5 Series Sedan, 2015 6 Series Convertible, 2015 6 Series Coupe, 2014 X5, 2013-2014 X3, 2014-2015 3 Series Sedan, 2014 4 Series Coupe, 2014 4 Series Convertible, 2014 3 Series Gran Turismo, and 2015 4 Series Gran Coupe vehicles.  Please see the recall report for the complete list of models.  The driver's air bag inflator may explode during deployment, due to a manufacturing defect.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect Rim Information on Label/FMVSS 110 (35 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024 Forest River Salem, Wildwood, and Stealth EVO travel trailers.  The Federal Placard may state an incorrect rim size.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: Forest River, Inc.: Hitch May Fail (17 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024 Salem, Puma, Wildwood, and 2025 Cherokee travel trailers equipped with certain Pacific Rim brand couplers.  The couplers have an incorrect load rating of 14,000 pounds and may be overloaded, causing the hitch to fail.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Vehicle Roll Away from Software Error (12,349 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2024 Santa Fe vehicles.  A software error in the transmission control unit may result in a vehicle roll away when the vehicle is in PARK.
